items.headline: CMBS investors grow cautious as AI-linked data-center debt spreads widen
items.note: Two of the last three data-center-backed CMBS deals (KKR's CyrusOne, Blackstone's QTS) had to reprice wider than initial talk to clear, concrete evidence private-market appetite for AI-linked debt is softening.

items.headline: Oracle's 5-year CDS spread hits highest level since 2008
items.note: Oracle's 5-year CDS premium climbed to roughly 203bp even as the equity rebounds, underscoring persistent credit-market unease over the capex-driven cash burn behind July's S&P downgrade to BBB-.
